Package com.codedstream.otterstream.runtime.lifecycle

Class ManagedModel

java.lang.Object
com.codedstream.otterstream.runtime.lifecycle.ManagedModel
public class ManagedModel extends Object
A model identity (a stable modelId) whose underlying InferenceEngine can be hot-swapped, canaried, and shadowed over time without callers ever holding a stale reference.

Three independent traffic slots are tracked:

  • primary — always present once a version is deployed; serves the rest of traffic
  • canary — optional; receives a configurable percentage of traffic (see LifecycleManager.deployCanary(com.codedstream.otterstream.inference.config.ModelConfig, int))
  • shadow — optional; receives a sampled copy of traffic asynchronously, purely for comparison — never affects what's returned to the caller (see LifecycleManager.deployShadow(java.lang.String, com.codedstream.otterstream.inference.config.ModelConfig, double))

Callers should always go through infer(Map) rather than caching an engine themselves — the whole point of ManagedModel is that routing can change out from under you between two calls, atomically and without ever exposing a partially-initialized engine.

Since:
0.1.0

    • infer

      public InferenceResult infer(Map<String,Object> inputs) throws InferenceException
      Runs inference, routed between primary and canary (if any) according to getCanaryTrafficPercent(), and — if a shadow deployment is active — fires a sampled, asynchronous, non-blocking copy of the request at the shadow engine for comparison. The shadow call never affects the value returned here.
      Parameters:
      inputs - inference inputs
      Returns:
      inference result from whichever engine (primary or canary) served this call
      Throws:
      InferenceException - if no version is deployed, or the serving engine call fails
